nodes.text:
Cantor Miriel sits on the steps of the silent organ, holding the empty glass jar in her lap. The frantic tension has gone out of her shoulders, leaving only a deep, quiet exhaustion.

"When the wire came off the pipe, I heard him clearly for the first time in a month," she whispers. "Not the three notes I kept forcing through the bellows—just Jonas, thanking me, and saying goodnight."

She reaches into her shawl and offers you a stoppered blue phial of memory-tallow. "The elders of the Hollow Choir deeper in the Archive of Vows told me that letting go was a betrayal. They were lying to themselves, and I lied to myself too. Take the tuning-tongue on the lectern, {player.name}, and give Nocturne back its bell."

choices.text: Keeper Maeve said there is a place for you by the Wayfarers' fire.
May Jonas rest in peace, Miriel.

nodes.text: Cantor Miriel traces the rim of the empty reliquary jar. "I'll come back to the square soon, {player.name}. I only want to sit in the quiet a little longer—real quiet, with no wires in it."
